name: Sequence Type 3 Code
definition: Specifies the type of the current transaction that belongs to a sequence of transactions.

FRST.name: First
FRST.definition: First collection of a series of direct debit instructions.

RCUR.name: Recurring
RCUR.definition: Direct debit instruction where the debtor's authorisation is used for regular direct debit transactions initiated by the creditor.

FNAL.name: Final
FNAL.definition: Final collection of a series of direct debit instructions.

OOFF.name: One Off
OOFF.definition: Direct debit instruction where the debtor's authorisation is used to initiate one single direct debit transaction.

RPRE.name: Represented
RPRE.definition: Collection used to re-present previously reversed or returned direct debit transactions.
